sop_thesis: **Healthpeak Properties, Inc. (DOC)** operates with a Wide Moat characterized by Proprietary IP, Customer Relationships & Market Presence. Leadership under Mr. Scott M. Brinker provides vital strategic execution and direction. The company targets a massive addressable runway (Real Estate expanding with secular adoption.). Financially, DOC trades at a trailing P/E of 57.43 (Forward P/E 143.57), P/S of 4.83, and PEG of 4.32, supported by leverage of D/E 1.09 and annual Free Cash Flow of $1.65B. Valuation triangulation indicates a DCF fair value of $99.07 and Wall Street mean target of $22.95 (Consensus: BUY). Technical configuration reflects Pullback Opportunity (30-48) with a 20/200 SMA trend alignment. **Conclusion & Stance:** STRONG BUY (PRIME DIP ENTRY). Prime accumulation window is identified at $20.09 - $20.69, targeting long-term upside to $23.62 with disciplined risk defined at $18.48.
